name: io.github.vuluu2k/sbuilder-mcp
title: Store Builder
description: Design, fill with real store data, render and publish Store Builder pages from an AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: SB_API
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Store Builder API. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

environmentVariables.name: SB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An API key from the store's Agent app (Apps → AI agent → Create key). Opens both the partner API and the private site API for that one store.

environmentVariables.name: SB_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A platform account, only for account-level calls a key cannot make (listing sites, members, roles).
